evidence: Added "Notes" text field via Configure Fields dialog; it appeared as a new column in table view, as a field in card view, and as a text input in the Add Entry form.
Added "QA Test Entry" with values for all 5 fields via Add Entry dialog; entry count went from 5 to 6 immediately and entry appeared in table with correct values.
Entered text "QA Test Entry", number 7, date 2026-09-01, checkbox checked=true; table shows "QA Test Entry","7","Sep 1, 2026", green check icon; card view shows same values with "Yes" for checkbox.
Switched from table to cards view; all 6 entries and their field values (including new Notes field) were identical in both views.

Sorted cards view by Priority ascending (1,1,2,2,3,7) then descending (7,3,2,2,1,1). Switching to table view reset sort selector to "Sort" (unset); sorting table by Priority column did not affect card view's retained Priority-descending sort when switching back.

Selecting "Priority" in Sort menu immediately reordered entries ascending; status text showed "Sorted by Priority (ascending)"; clicking again toggled to "Sorted by Priority (descending)" with correct order and app remained responsive.
After sorting by Priority ascending/descending, entry count remained 6 and all field values matched pre-sort values in both directions.

With no sort active, dragged entry-1's drag handle in table view producing new order (entry-1,4,2,5,3,QA); switching to cards view showed original order unaffected; dragging in cards view produced a different new order (entry-2,3,1,4,5,QA) that persisted independently when switching back to table view (which retained its own order).

Configure Fields dialog shows type dropdown with clearly labeled options Text/Number/Date/Checkbox. Add Entry form renders a textbox for Task Name, a spinbutton for Priority (number), a date-formatted textbox for Due Date, and a checkbox toggle labeled Yes/No for Completed.

Entry form checkbox toggle shows "No"/"Yes" text label. Table view shows distinct icons/colors: green check (text-success) for checked vs gray X (text-muted-foreground) for unchecked. Card view shows "Yes"/"No" text labels.

With sort cleared, drag handle appears only when no sort is active. Dragging entry-1's handle to entry-3's position in table view moved it cleanly to index 2 (Review,Update,Design,Prepare,Team,QA), preserving 6 entries and values. Cards view order remained independent (own separate manual order) after switching, and vice versa.

actual: No filter UI exists anywhere in the app. Toolbar only offers Fields, Sort, Table/Cards view toggle, Add Entry, and a quick-search box. Table column headers only expose sort-by-column buttons (verified via DOM inspection: header <th> only contain sort buttons, no filter icons/inputs). No element with "filter" in its attributes, class, or text was found in the DOM.

issue: Filtering feature is not implemented, so filter criteria cannot be applied or cleared
actual: No filter controls exist in the UI (confirmed via DOM inspection); there is no way to define field-specific filter criteria or verify inclusion/exclusion of entries based on criteria.

issue: Quick search matches only raw internal field values, not the formatted values displayed to users
actual: Searching "Jan 15" (the displayed date format shown in both table and card views) returned 0 entries, while searching the raw internal ISO value "2026-01-15" returned 1 matching entry. Searching "Yes" (the displayed checkbox state) returned 0 entries even though 3 entries display "Yes" for Completed.

evidence: Searching "landing" and "LANDING" both matched 1 entry (case-insensitive), status bar updated to '1 entry matching "landing"'. Clicking clear-search button restored count to "6 entries" with all entries visible.

All 6 entries and every field (including new Notes field) display consistently across table and card views with matching values. Empty Notes values are shown as "—" in both table and card views for entries without a note.
Priority number input (type=number) rejected keyboard letters "a","b","c" (value stayed "0"); valid numeric input "42" was accepted and saved correctly, displaying as "42" in the table.

Due Date input (type=date) sanitized invalid date "2026-02-30" (non-existent Feb 30) to empty value automatically, preventing an invalid date from being saved. Valid date "2026-10-10" was accepted and saved, displaying correctly as "Oct 10, 2026" in the table.

issue: Import feature is not implemented in the UI
actual: No import control (button, file input, or menu option) exists anywhere in the app. Searched the toolbar, Configure Fields dialog (which only references "Configure fields before importing data" in a note, with no actual import affordance), and the full DOM for any file input or import-related control — none found. There is no way to import data to test schema-based rejection of mismatched values.
